title: Identifying your ball
question: When are you allowed to lift your golf ball to check if it is yours?

choices.text: Only if it is on the putting green
If you first mark its position and need to identify it
Never; you must always play it as it lies

explanation: If you cannot identify your ball, you may mark its position and lift it anywhere on the course to check – not just on the putting green.
imagePrompt: A teen boy golfer marking his ball’s position in the rough before picking it up to check if it is his.
imageAlt: Teen boy golfer marking and identifying his ball in the rough.

issues: The left-handedness is not strongly indicated in the posture given no club is present, but this is acceptably minor for this specific scenario.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Ensure the golfer’s posture more clearly suggests left-handedness, such as marking/lifting with the left hand more prominently if possible.
